revisionWindowNote: Seeking Alpha displayed 1M/3M/6M revision % only; 7D/30D/90D fields = Data unavailable. Dashboard uses 1M as the primary short-window revision proxy (not identical to 30D).
calendarAlignmentRule: Fiscal period ending Jan-Mar → calendar year = ending year - 1; otherwise calendar year = ending year. Reported labels never overwritten.
mappingRule: Slot mapping only (not true calendar-year EPS): Fiscal Period Ending Jan–Mar → prior calendar year slot; otherwise ending year slot. Reported Fiscal Period Ending labels are always preserved. True calendar-year EPS requires summing Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4 consensus with all four present (never interpolated).
momentumFormula: Deterministic from Y+1 and Y+2 1M EPS revisions only: both >1% → Strong Positive; Y+1>0 and Y+2>=0 → Positive; both <-1% → Strong Negative; Y+1<0 and Y+2<=0 → Negative; else Neutral. No model, guidance, or driver mix-in.
